title: Request
description: An individual HTTP request within a collection

rootUrl.description: Overrides the collection and environment root URL for this request only.

relativeUrl.description: Path appended to the nearest root URL (collection's or environment's), unless rootUrl is set.

headers.description: HTTP headers to include with the request

body.description: Request body. Serialized as JSON unless overridden by a Content-Type header.

jqFilter.description: Default jq filter applied to the response. Can be overridden at runtime.
